description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Space Wolves BIRTH OF A SAGA (Champions of Fenris, 1 CP) — WP-S3. Fixture sw11e_s3_active (P1 Space Wolves ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sw11e_s3_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Wolves player gets all three Space Wolves detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. The player ends the Command phase with real clicks; command_phase_main offers BIRTH OF A SAGA on the non-CHARACTER, non-VEHICLE units; a real click on 'Use on Wolf Guard Terminators' spends 1 CP; the unit has the CHARACTER keyword (so HEROIC RESOLVE / CHAMPION'S GUIDANCE can now target it) until the start of the player's next Command phase.
